caption: RECIPE BELOW👇 These frozen cotton candy grapes are sweet, sour, crunchy, and such a fun way to turn fresh fruit into a candy-like treat!  Save this the next time you’re craving something sweet and share with a friend who needs to try this! Follow for more healthy recipes that taste just like your favorite treats! recipe modified from @healthylittlepeach COTTON CANDY GRAPES  Makes 8 servings | about ½ cup per serving Ingredients * 4 cups green grapes, washed and dried * 1 cup granulated monk fruit sweetener  * Juice of 2 limes Instructions 1. Line a large baking sheet or dish with parchment paper. 2. Add the grapes and fresh lime juice to a large bowl. Toss until the grapes are evenly coated, then refrigerate for 10 minutes. 3. Remove the grapes from the refrigerator and roll each grape in the monk fruit sweetener mixture until completely coated. 4. Arrange the coated grapes in a single layer on the parchment-lined pan. 5. Freeze for 2–3 hours, or until completely frozen. 6. Grab a handful straight from the freezer and enjoy your “cotton candy”!  Estimated nutrition per serving (½ cup): ~50 calories | ~13g carbs | ~1g protein | 0g fat | ~1g fiber | 0g added sugar
